facts.fact: The employee and the employer each contribute 12% of basic wages plus dearness allowance
facts.quote: Both employee and employer contribute 12% of basic wages + dearness allowance.

facts.fact: The employee's whole contribution goes to EPF
facts.quote: Employee’s entire contribution goes to EPF.

facts.fact: The employer's share is split between EPF, EPS (pension) and EDLI (insurance)
facts.quote: Employer’s share is split between EPF, Employees’ Pension Scheme (EPS), and Employees’ Deposit Linked Insurance (EDLI).

summary: EPFO EPF Scheme page still states 12% each, employee share fully to EPF, employer share split EPF/EPS/EDLI; all confirmed.
